domestic.title: 国内多家人工智能实验室发布新一代开源大模型，推理成本下降超六成
domestic.summary: 多家国内 AI 实验室联合发布新一代开源大模型系列，在多项基准测试中表现接近闭源旗舰模型，同时通过混合专家架构与推理优化，将单次推理成本降低超过 60%，引发开源社区广泛关注。

domestic.title: 智能体（Agent）加速落地：多家企业将 AI 助手接入核心业务流程
domestic.summary: 随着多模态与工具调用能力成熟，AI 智能体正在从演示走向生产环境。多家大型企业已将其接入客服、研发与供应链环节，报告显示自动化处理率平均提升超过 40%。

domestic.title: 国家人工智能产业政策加码：算力基础设施与数据要素市场同步推进
domestic.summary: 相关部门发布新一轮人工智能产业支持政策，重点覆盖算力基础设施建设、高质量数据集开放与行业大模型应用示范，多个城市同步出台配套补贴与人才引进措施。

domestic.title: AI 编程助手渗透率创新高：国内开发者人均节省工时报告发布
domestic.summary: 最新开发者生态报告显示，国内开发者 AI 编程助手使用率突破新高，人均每周节省编码时间超过 5 小时，代码审查与测试环节的自动化程度显著提升。

domestic.title: 多模态视频生成模型迎来新突破：分钟级长视频生成进入产品化阶段
domestic.summary: 国内视频生成赛道密集发布新品，多款模型支持分钟级连贯长视频生成，物理一致性与角色一致性大幅改善，创作者工具与影视制作流程开始批量接入。

domestic.title: AI 芯片国产化进程加快：多款推理芯片完成量产验证
domestic.summary: 多家芯片企业宣布推理芯片完成量产验证并开始规模出货，在主流大模型推理场景中能效比表现出色，为国内大模型部署成本下降提供硬件支撑。

domestic.title: 大模型进入教育场景：多省中小学开展 AI 辅助教学试点
domestic.summary: 教育部门推进 AI 辅助教学试点，覆盖个性化作业辅导、教师备课辅助与学情分析等场景，试点学校反馈学生自主学习效率与教师备课效率均有提升。

domestic.title: 开源社区热议：国产推理框架新版本性能提升明显
domestic.summary: 国产大模型推理框架发布新版本，通过算子融合与动态批处理优化，在消费级显卡上的推理吞吐提升显著，社区贡献者数量持续增长。

domestic.title: AI 安全治理受重视：国内首个大模型安全评估标准落地
domestic.summary: 国内首个大模型安全评估团体标准正式实施，覆盖内容安全、隐私保护与对抗鲁棒性等维度，头部大模型厂商已开始按标准开展自评估。

domestic.title: 具身智能热度持续：多家人形机器人企业公布量产计划
domestic.summary: 具身智能赛道融资与量产消息密集，多家企业公布人形机器人小批量产时间表，核心零部件与具身大模型成为竞争焦点。

abroad.title: Frontier AI labs race to extend context windows as enterprise demand grows
abroad.summary: Major AI labs are competing to extend context windows into the millions of tokens, driven by enterprise demand for document-level reasoning and codebase-scale analysis in production workloads.

abroad.title: EU AI Act enforcement begins: what developers need to know
abroad.summary: The first wave of EU AI Act obligations took effect this month, requiring transparency disclosures and risk assessments for general-purpose AI systems, with significant implications for developers worldwide.

abroad.title: Venture funding in AI infrastructure hits record quarter
abroad.summary: AI infrastructure startups raised record funding this quarter, with data center networking, inference optimization and synthetic data companies leading the surge, according to new market data.

abroad.title: Open-source models close the gap on proprietary benchmarks
abroad.summary: New evaluation results show top open-weight models now trail the best closed models by single-digit percentage points across major benchmarks, intensifying the open vs. closed debate.

abroad.title: AI agents move into enterprise workflows at scale
abroad.summary: Enterprise adoption of autonomous AI agents accelerated this quarter, with major software vendors shipping agentic features for finance, support and operations, and CIOs reporting measurable productivity gains.

abroad.title: Researchers propose new technique to cut LLM inference energy use
abroad.summary: A research team demonstrated a token-pruning technique that cuts inference energy consumption by up to half with minimal accuracy loss, addressing growing concerns about data center power demand.

abroad.title: Chipmakers unveil next-gen AI accelerators targeting inference workloads
abroad.summary: Leading chipmakers announced next-generation accelerators optimized for large-scale inference, promising significant gains in tokens-per-dollar as model serving costs become the industry's core economic challenge.

abroad.title: AI-generated content labeling standard gains cross-platform support
abroad.summary: A coalition of platforms and model providers adopted a common metadata standard for labeling AI-generated media, aiming to curb deepfakes and improve content provenance transparency.

abroad.title: Synthetic data startups attract attention as real-world data hits limits
abroad.summary: As high-quality human-generated training data becomes scarce and expensive, synthetic data generation is emerging as a key bottleneck-solving technology, drawing significant investment and debate over quality control.

abroad.title: Multimodal benchmarks show dramatic gains in visual reasoning
abroad.summary: Latest multimodal evaluation rounds show large improvements in visual reasoning and spatial understanding, with several models now outperforming human baselines on curated benchmark suites.
